patterns.description: A hardcoded /{resource}/create path string. AD-24's create route is /{resource}/new (Story 3.12); every live link goes through entityPaths.ts's buildNewPath, never a template literal.

ra-core's useCreatePath({ type: 'create' | 'edit' | 'show' }) hardcodes the pre-AD-24 path shapes (useCreatePath.js:46-62). Only the three admin-kit buttons that this story overrides may keep one fallback call each, for resources with no registered entity descriptor.

redirect="show" resolves through useCreatePath's hardcoded /{resource}/{id}/show (useRedirect.js:55). Story 3.12 replaces every use with redirect={redirectToRecord}, which follows the descriptor's own buildRecordPath instead.
